description: Hackney Controlled Parking Zones is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by London Borough of Hackney. Boundaries definining Parking Zones within the borough. These have been introduced to improve parking conditions for local residents and businesses. They also help traffic, pedestrians and cyclists move safely in the borough. Parking Zones restrict car parking to holders of parking permits, usually but not exclusively local residents and business owners. Coverage: London Borough of Hackney. The portal files it under the publisher London Borough of Hackney. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
